name: Leia Track App
summary: Head tracking bridge for Simulated Reality (glasses-free 3D) displays. Feeds tracking data from OpenTrack or VRto3D to enable head-coupled parallax on SR monitors like Acer SpatialLabs.
notes: Leia Track App sits between a head tracker (OpenTrack, webcam, etc.) and the SR display system. It enables the display to shift the rendered views based on head position, significantly improving the glasses-free 3D effect — especially for single viewers.
install_notes: No automated install. Requires OpenTrack or compatible tracker as prerequisite. See GitHub for setup instructions.
